title: Corner C5 - XP & Leveling Visual Spec
summary: Visual spec for XP system, level badges, streak indicators, progress bars, level-up celebration animation, leaderboard. Turns accumulated C3 data into a visible engagement loop.
content:
Corner C5: XP & Leveling Visual Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For: Bobby (implementation) | Steve (product owner) Depends on: C3 XP data model (xp_events + xp_totals tables already accumulating) Context: By C5, months of XP data exist. This spec makes it visible.

Design Philosophy

The XP system should feel rewarding without feeling childish. A CPA at a Phoenix accounting firm checks their agent's level and feels a small hit of satisfaction, not embarrassment. The visual language: RPG stats treated with the seriousness of a credit score. The numbers matter. The progression is visible. The celebration is brief and sharp, not clown-show confetti.

1. Agent Level Badge (Megaboard Party Screen)

The "LV --" placeholder from C3 becomes a real badge.

Badge Design

+--------+
| LV  7  |
+--------+

Container:

  • Display: inline-flex, align-items: center, gap: 3px
  • Padding: 3px 8px
  • Border-radius: 6px
  • Border: 1px solid accent-gold (#C9A84C) at 25%
  • Background: accent-gold at 8%

Typography:

  • "LV" prefix: JetBrains Mono 600, 9px, accent-gold at 60%, uppercase
  • Level number: JetBrains Mono 800, 13px, accent-gold
  • Gap between "LV" and number: 3px

Level Tiers (Visual Progression)

The badge evolves as level increases. Each tier has a distinct border treatment:

Level Range Tier Name Border Color Background Extra
1-4 Bronze #A0785A at 25% #A0785A at 6% None
5-9 Silver #9CA3AF at 25% #9CA3AF at 6% None
10-19 Gold #C9A84C at 25% #C9A84C at 8% Subtle shimmer (CSS animation, 3s, barely visible)
20-49 Platinum #A78BFA at 25% #A78BFA at 8% Inner glow (box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px #A78BFA14)
50+ Diamond #38BDF8 at 30% #38BDF8 at 10% Rotating gradient border (CSS conic-gradient animation, very slow, 8s)

Number color always matches the tier's primary color. The "LV" prefix stays at 60% opacity of that color.

Badge Placement

Location Size Notes
Megaboard Party Screen card 13px number Top-right of card, next to status dot
Megaboard Agent Deep-dive 13px number Next to agent name
Checklist agent header 11px number, smaller badge Right of agent name
HUD drawer agent row 11px number Far right, compact badge
Game mode agent tooltip 11px number In tooltip popup
Profile / Settings 16px number Large display next to business name

2. XP Progress Bar

Shows progress from current level to next level.

Bar Design

XP [=============---------] 2,847 / 3,600

Container: flex row, gap 8px, width 100%, align-items: center

Label:

  • "XP": JetBrains Mono 500, 8px, text-muted, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.15em
  • Width: 20px, flex-shrink: 0

Bar Track:

  • Flex: 1
  • Height: 8px
  • Border-radius: 4px
  • Background: #1A2030 (same as HP bar empty)

Bar Fill:

  • Height: 100%
  • Border-radius: 4px
  • Background: accent-gold (#C9A84C)
  • Width: (current_xp - level_start_xp) / (level_end_xp - level_start_xp) * 100%
  • Animation: width transition 600ms ease-out (smooth growth when XP is earned)
  • Subtle gradient: linear-gradient(90deg, #C9A84C, #D4B65E) for depth

XP Count:

  • JetBrains Mono 700, 11px, text-primary
  • Format: "[current] / [next_level_threshold]"
  • Width: auto, flex-shrink: 0

XP Bar Placement

Location Show Full Bar? Notes
Megaboard Party Screen card No, too small Level badge only
Megaboard Agent Deep-dive Yes Below HP bar
Megaboard PARTY section header Yes Total business XP, replaces "-- XP" placeholder
Profile / Settings Yes Large version, 12px bar height
Weekly Recap Yes Shows weekly XP gain highlighted

3. Streak Indicator

Flame Icon Visual

The streak flame grows with the streak length.

Streak Icon Color Animation
1-2 days Small flame (16px) #F59E0B at 50% (faded) None
3-6 days Small flame (16px) #F59E0B (full) Subtle flicker (opacity 0.85-1.0, 2s)
7-13 days Medium flame (20px) #F97316 Flicker + gentle sway (translateX -1px to 1px, 3s)
14-29 days Large flame (24px) #EF4444 Flicker + sway + inner glow
30+ days Roaring flame (28px) #EF4444 with #F59E0B core Full animation: flicker + sway + particle sparks (tiny 2px circles rising from top, fading out)

Flame Composition

The flame is CSS-only (no image file). Uses layered pseudo-elements:

  • Core: ellipse, light color (gold or yellow)
  • Outer: teardrop shape, darker color (orange or red)
  • Spark particles (30+ days only): 3-4 tiny circles with upward float + fade animation

Bobby can use a Lucide Flame icon with color overrides for simplicity. Or build a custom CSS flame for the premium feel.

Streak Badge

[flame] 14  2x

Container:

  • Display: inline-flex, align-items: center, gap: 6px
  • Padding: 4px 10px
  • Border-radius: 8px
  • Background: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.08) (warm tint, streak-appropriate)
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.15)

Streak Count:

  • JetBrains Mono 700, 14px, #F97316
  • The number of consecutive days

Multiplier:

  • JetBrains Mono 600, 10px, accent-gold
  • Format: "1.5x", "2x", "2.5x", "3x"
  • Only shown for 3+ day streaks (when multiplier activates)

Streak Badge Placement

Location Notes
HUD bar (desktop) Right side, near the clock/time display. Always visible.
HUD bar (mobile) Compact: flame + number only, no multiplier
Megaboard PARTY header Next to total XP
Profile / Settings Large version with streak calendar heatmap
Weekly Recap Prominent display with streak history

Streak Break Warning

When the streak is about to break (no tasks completed today, and it's past 6 PM in client timezone):

  • Streak badge pulses gently (opacity 0.6 to 1.0, 2s cycle)
  • Tooltip on hover: "Complete a task to keep your streak! Resets at midnight."
  • Toast notification (if push notifications enabled): "Your [N]-day streak ends in [hours]. One task keeps it alive."

4. Level-Up Celebration

When an agent crosses a level threshold:

Animation Sequence (2.5 seconds total)

Beat 1 (0-0.3s): Level badge flash

  • Level badge scales 1.0 > 1.4 > 1.0 (spring, 300ms)
  • Brief white flash (opacity 0.3 > 0, 200ms) behind the badge
  • Old level number fades out, new number fades in (crossfade 200ms)

Beat 2 (0.3-1.0s): Gold particle burst

  • 8-12 gold circles (3-5px each) burst outward from the badge position
  • Trajectory: random angles, 60-120px travel distance
  • Fade out over 400ms (opacity 1 > 0)
  • Slight gravity: particles arc downward
  • Color: accent-gold (#C9A84C) with slight opacity variation

Beat 3 (0.8-1.5s): XP bar flash

  • XP bar fill resets to 0% (new level, new progress)
  • Flash: bar track briefly pulses accent-gold at 30% (200ms)

Beat 4 (1.2-2.5s): Toast notification

  • Special toast type (not one of the 4 standard types)
  • Gold left accent
  • Icon: star or trophy (Lucide Star, accent-gold)
  • Agent avatar + name
  • Message: "[Agent] reached Level [N]!"
  • Auto-dismiss: 6 seconds (slightly longer, celebration moment)

Sound (Opt-in)

  • Short ascending chime, 3 notes, 500ms total
  • Similar to a game achievement sound
  • Volume: 25% of system volume
  • Only plays if corner-sound-enabled localStorage flag is true
  • Audio file: pre-loaded .mp3, < 50KB

Level-Up in Game Mode

If the user is in Game mode when an agent levels up:

  • Agent character does a brief celebration animation (arms up, or small jump)
  • Gold sparkle particles around the agent sprite (4-6 particles, 1 second)
  • This uses the existing sprite system. Bobby renders the celebration sprite state.

5. Business Level (Aggregate)

The entire business has a level, aggregated from all agent XP.

Display

HUD Bar (always visible):

CORNER.   [flame 14]  [LV 8 | 12,400 XP]   [Game] [Checklist] [Megaboard]
  • Business level badge: same tier-based styling as agent badges
  • Total XP shown next to level: JetBrains Mono 400, 10px, text-muted
  • Compact on mobile: just the level badge, no XP text

Profile / Settings page:

  • Large business level display
  • XP progress bar (wide, 12px height)
  • Total XP earned all-time
  • XP earned this week / this month
  • Level history chart (small sparkline: level over time, 12 weeks)

6. Leaderboard

Access

  • In-app: Settings > Leaderboard
  • Public (opt-in): corner.app/leaderboard
  • Default: private. Client chooses to participate.

Layout

+------------------------------------------------------------+
|  LEADERBOARD                          This Week  All Time  |
+------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                            |
|  #1  [Crown]  Phoenix CPA Group     LV 12   8,400 XP      |
|  #2           Ambition Mechanical   LV 10   6,200 XP      |
|  #3           Mesa Contractors      LV  8   4,100 XP      |
|  ...                                                       |
|  #7   YOU     Your Business Name    LV  5   2,100 XP      |
|                                                            |
+------------------------------------------------------------+

Row Design

Container: padding 14px 20px, border-bottom 1px solid border

Rank:

  • JetBrains Mono 700, 16px, text-primary
  • #1: accent-gold color
  • #2: #9CA3AF (silver)
  • #3: #A0785A (bronze)
  • Others: text-muted

Crown Icon (top 3 only):

  • Lucide Crown, 16px
  • Color matches rank (gold/silver/bronze)
  • Only for top 3

Business Name:

  • Space Grotesk 500, 14px, text-primary
  • If private: "Anonymous Business" or just their city/industry
  • If the current user's row: "YOU" badge in accent color before the name

Level Badge: Standard tier-based badge

XP:

  • JetBrains Mono 500, 13px, text-secondary
  • Right-aligned

Time Filters

  • "This Week" / "All Time" toggle
  • Same tab styling as mode switcher but smaller
  • Default: This Week

Your Row Highlight

  • When the current user's business appears in the list:
  • Background: accent at 5%
  • Border-left: 3px solid accent
  • "YOU" badge: JetBrains Mono 700, 9px, accent, bg accent at 10%, padding 2px 6px, border-radius 4px

Privacy Controls

  • "Your leaderboard profile" section at the top
  • Toggle: "Show my business on the leaderboard" (default OFF)
  • When ON: choose what to show:
    • Business name or anonymous
    • City/state or hidden
    • Industry or hidden
  • Preview: "This is how you appear to others: [preview]"

7. XP Earned Notification (Real-time)

When XP is earned during a session:

Micro-animation (Non-intrusive)

A small "+10 XP" floats up from the source (e.g., when a task is completed):

  • Position: appears near the completed task card or the agent's room
  • Text: JetBrains Mono 600, 12px, accent-gold
  • Format: "+10 XP" (or "+15 XP" with streak bonus)
  • Animation: float up (translateY 0 to -30px), fade out (opacity 1 to 0), 800ms ease-out
  • If streak bonus: show multiplier in smaller text below: "2x streak!" in JetBrains Mono 400, 9px, accent-gold at 60%

This animation does NOT stack. If 3 tasks complete at once, show "+30 XP" once, not 3 separate animations.

HUD XP Counter Update

When XP is earned:

  • Business level XP counter in HUD briefly flashes (text scales 1.0 > 1.05 > 1.0, 300ms)
  • Number counts up to new total (countUp animation, 400ms)

Responsive Considerations

Element Desktop Mobile
Streak badge in HUD Flame + count + multiplier Flame + count only
Business level in HUD Badge + XP text Badge only
Level-up particles 8-12 particles 4-6 particles (performance)
Leaderboard Full table Compact card per row
XP progress bar Full width with label Full width, no label (level badge suffices)
"+N XP" micro-animation Near source element Top of screen, centered

Performance Notes

  • Level-up celebration should use CSS animations, not heavy Canvas/WebGL
  • Particle burst: CSS pseudo-elements or lightweight SVG, not a particle library
  • Flame animation: CSS only, no JavaScript animation frames
  • XP counter: requestAnimationFrame-based countUp, not setInterval
  • Streak check: computed server-side, sent in the dashboard API response. No client-side date math.

XP makes the invisible visible. Every task completed, every streak maintained, every level earned is proof that the AI team is working. The numbers go up. The badges get shinier. The flame burns brighter. That's the hook.
